S0432.reason: After Bennett, English courts may stay for abuse of process where extradition was bypassed, but they exercise that discretion only exceptionally.

S0598.reason: VCLT Article 19(c) makes a reservation impermissible when it is incompatible with the treaty’s object and purpose, without requiring a court ruling.

S0272.reason: SDS denatures proteins and imposes a uniform charge-to-mass ratio so the gel separates polypeptides by chain length alone.
